eed672d600bf7181.title: Art for a Life Free From Violence
eed672d600bf7181.desc: The Art for a Life Free from Violence exhibit is an opportunity to express and show our reactions to experiences of violence which are often silenced or overlooked. The theme emphasizes the role of art as both witness and reaction. The intention is to demonstrate that art can be a platform for processing experiences and demonstrating care, advocacy, and unity. To see is to acknowledge the reality of harm without denial. To hear is to believe stories as they are shared, without judgment or minimization. To stand with is to move beyond sympathy into collective responsibility, support, and change. Exhibit: 12/4/26-12/6/26 Exhibit Closing Celebration and Awards Night: 12/6/26 2PM

eee245f43878de52.title: Damian's Not So Haunted House
eee245f43878de52.desc: Come for a 0% scary and 100% Halloween fun for all ages, specifically catered to the very youngest trick-or-treaters. The experience is like Disneyland's Haunted Mansion attraction turned into a Mickey Mouse Clubhouse episode. The Not-So-Haunted house is open to the public October 16-17, 22-24, and Oct 27 - Oct 31 from 5-8 PM. The event is put on by a mother fighting for her son's life. 7-year-old Damian is currently suffering from the rare and fatal genetic disease called ASMD (also known as Niemann-Pick Disease Type A or baby Alzheimer's). You can visit SaveDamian.com to read Damian's full story. Damian's mom is transforming her garage into Damian’s Not-So-Haunted house, complete with a photo spot opportunity, an engaging walkthrough, and Disneyland decor straight from Disney’s exclusive vault. You can read all about what to expect here. You can also support by buying shirts promoting the event here - they glow in the dark! All funds raised at the Not-So-Haunted House go to the Wylder Nation Foundation (WNF), which is the only organization laser-focused on developing the treatment needed to save Damian's life. This year’s goal is to raise $15,000, and we can accomplish it with…
